title: Ops sandbox: scripting stubs and chaos sanitizer
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an isolated ops sandbox and a library of safe scripting stubs plus a runtime "chaos-sanitizer" that prevents destructive remediation steps from executing in uncontrolled contexts. This ticket covers: (1) a lightweight local sandbox environment for rehearsing runbook tasks against synthetic state; (2) a curated set of idempotent scripting stubs (JS/Python/Bash) with guard rails and explicit compensation steps; (3) a sanitizer runtime that performs static + runtime checks and injects automatic rollbacks where possible before executing operator actions on production endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox environment can load a recorded incident trace and allow an operator to step through taskified runbook entries without touching production (no network egress to prod by default)
Library contains 12 verified scripting stubs covering common remediation classes (restart pods, circuit breaker toggle, cache flush, DB read-only toggle) with test harness and idempotency assertions
Chaos-sanitizer surface blocks or simulates destructive operations by default and logs a proposed compensation plan; operators can explicitly approve elevated execution in Dedicated mode
End-to-end test: simulate a broken KV-cache incident and execute a scripted repair in the sandbox; sanitizer must detect missing compensation for a step and attach a rollback stub
Telemetry: each sandbox run emits a replay artifact link and a diff of state changes suitable for debugging and audit
tasks: Design sandbox network isolation and synthetic-state loader
Define scripting-stub interface and common metadata (preconditions, compensation, safety tags)
Implement chaos-sanitizer static analyzer (pattern rules + denylist)
Hook sanitizer runtime into ops CLI and the runbooks-as-tasks executor
Add E2E replay test with recorded incident (kv-cache failure scenario)
Create docs + quickstart for oncall and SREs; record a demo video

2025-11-15 - Miguel S: Implemented compensation stub injection prototype. Edge case: when compensation requires DB roll-forward, show a manual intervention step rather than auto-injecting.
2025-11-18 - PM feedback (Sara L): Prioritize the KV-cache repair scenario demo for next all-hands. Also requested a short-run security review for sanitizer rule allowlist mechanics.
